meta.reviewer: 4 parallel general-purpose linguist agents (one per locale), in plan mode
rubric: natural register for K-3 teacher/parent audience
locale punctuation conventions (em-dash vs en-dash, etc.)
specifically flag: fonetik/fonetikk/fonetiikka (= academic phonetics) vs phonics (= K-3 reading instruction); K-3 grade-range marker; locale list inside whatWeOfferBody
meta.outputContract: per key: verdict (ok|fix) + correction (if fix) + reason

phonics_mistranslation.explanation: English 'phonics' = letter-sound reading instruction for early readers. The current translations all use the academic phonetics word (= the study of speech sounds), which is the wrong concept. K-3 teachers in each locale use a specific reading-instruction term.

intro_drops_affordances.explanation: English intro enumerates four affordances ('browse, print, share, embed') + 'no signup required'. The current translations collapse this to a vague 'fritt tilgängligt/frit tilgængeligt/fritt tilgjengelig/vapaasti käytettävissä — ingen registrering/ei rekisteröintiä'. The four verbs are load-bearing for K-3 teachers who need to know exactly what they can do with the resources. Restored in all four corrections.

K3_grade_range.explanation: K-3 is American kindergarten-grade 3 shorthand. Per-locale adaptation per agent recommendation: sv = F-3 (Swedish equivalent); da/no = expand to børnehaveklasse til 3. klasse / barnehage til 3. trinn on first mention; fi = gloss as 'esi- ja alkuopetuksen'.

tidig_barndom_clinical_register.explanation: 'In early childhood' / 'tidig barndom / tidlig barndom / varhaislapsuus' is a literal calque that reads clinical/developmental-psychology in all four Nordic+Finnic locales. Replaced with classroom-friendly terms per agent.

da.operator_consideration: Danish has no widely-shared single-word distinction between 'dual-language' (immersion) and 'bilingual' (individual bilingualism). The corrections use 'sprogbadsklasser' (language-bath classes) vs 'tosprogede klasser' to preserve the English three-way distinction. Operator may verify this distinction is load-bearing for Danish audiences or accept the simpler two-way 'tosprogede klasser og internationale skoler' framing.
